meta.note: Work, money and digital life in Portugal.

cards.ex_t: A reunião de equipa começa às dez, logo a seguir ao café.
cards.ex_trans: The team meeting starts at ten, right after coffee.

cards.ex_t: Hoje vou a pé para o trabalho porque o autocarro está atrasado.
cards.ex_trans: Today I'm walking to work because the bus is late.

cards.ex_t: A empresa deixa-me trabalhar a partir de casa dois dias por semana.
cards.ex_trans: The company lets me work from home two days a week.

cards.note: Same form for both sexes: o colega / a colega — only the article changes.
cards.ex_t: Vou almoçar com um colega perto do Mercado dos Lavradores.
cards.ex_trans: I'm having lunch with a colleague near the Lavradores Market.

cards.ex_t: O chefe quer o dashboard pronto antes da reunião de sexta.
cards.ex_trans: The boss wants the dashboard ready before Friday's meeting.

cards.ex_t: O cliente pediu mais uma alteração ao relatório de vendas.
cards.ex_trans: The client asked for one more change to the sales report.

cards.ex_t: Este projeto de dados tem de estar fechado até ao fim do mês.
cards.ex_trans: This data project has to be wrapped up by the end of the month.

cards.note: Deadline — but also shelf life: every yogurt has a 'prazo de validade' (expiry date).
cards.ex_t: O prazo para entregar o relatório é sexta-feira ao meio-dia.
cards.ex_trans: The deadline to hand in the report is Friday at noon.

cards.ex_t: Enviei o relatório mensal ao chefe antes do almoço.
cards.ex_trans: I sent the monthly report to the boss before lunch.

cards.note: Always plural: 'os dados estão limpos'. Singular 'o dado' is a die (the one you roll).
cards.ex_t: Os dados de vendas chegam todas as manhãs num ficheiro CSV.
cards.ex_trans: The sales data arrives every morning in a CSV file.

cards.note: pt-PT; Brazil says 'arquivo'. In Portugal 'arquivo' means an archive.
cards.ex_t: Não consigo abrir o ficheiro que me enviaste ontem.
cards.ex_trans: I can't open the file you sent me yesterday.

cards.ex_t: Deixei o computador do trabalho a atualizar durante a noite.
cards.ex_trans: I left the work computer updating overnight.

cards.note: pt-PT; Brazil says 'tela'. In Portugal 'tela' is a painter's canvas.
cards.ex_t: Trabalho muito melhor com um segundo ecrã em casa.
cards.ex_trans: I work much better with a second screen at home.

cards.note: pt-PT for the computer mouse — Brazil keeps the English 'mouse'. Also the animal.
cards.ex_t: Comprei um rato novo para o computador do escritório.
cards.ex_trans: I bought a new mouse for the office computer.

cards.note: pt-PT; Brazil says 'senha'. In Portugal 'senha' is the queue ticket you pull at AIMA, the Finanças or the pharmacy.
cards.ex_t: Mudei outra vez a palavra-passe do e-mail da empresa.
cards.ex_trans: I changed the company email password yet again.

cards.note: Formal term — in speech everyone says 'o e-mail'. pt-PT accent: eletrónico, not the Brazilian eletrônico.
cards.ex_t: Recebi a fatura da luz por correio eletrónico.
cards.ex_trans: I received the electricity bill by email.

cards.note: In Portugal every café asks 'Fatura com contribuinte?' — whether you want your tax number on the receipt.
cards.ex_t: Pediste a fatura com contribuinte no café?
cards.ex_trans: Did you ask for the receipt with your tax number at the café?

cards.note: Everyday pt-PT word for salary ('salário' also works; Brazil uses only 'salário').
cards.ex_t: O ordenado cai na conta no último dia útil do mês.
cards.ex_trans: The salary lands in the account on the last working day of the month.

cards.ex_t: O IVA já está incluído no preço do menu do almoço.
cards.ex_trans: VAT is already included in the price of the lunch menu.

cards.note: False friend for US ears: in Portugal the IRS is the personal income tax itself, not an agency — the tax office is 'as Finanças'.
cards.ex_t: Entreguei o IRS online no Portal das Finanças em abril.
cards.ex_trans: I filed my income tax online on the tax office portal in April.

cards.ex_t: Abri uma conta bancária cá para receber o ordenado.
cards.ex_trans: I opened a bank account here to receive my salary.

cards.ex_t: Pedimos um empréstimo ao banco para comprar um apartamento no Funchal.
cards.ex_trans: We asked the bank for a loan to buy a flat in Funchal.

cards.ex_t: Todos os meses vai uma parte do ordenado para a poupança.
cards.ex_trans: Every month part of the salary goes into savings.

cards.ex_t: Vou transferir a renda por MB WAY ainda hoje.
cards.ex_trans: I'm going to transfer the rent by MB WAY later today.

cards.ex_t: Levo o almoço de casa para poupar algum dinheiro.
cards.ex_trans: I bring lunch from home to save some money.

cards.ex_t: Tento não gastar mais de dez euros por dia em cafés.
cards.ex_trans: I try not to spend more than ten euros a day on coffees.

cards.note: Covers both 'to earn' (ganhar bem) and 'to win' (ganhar um prémio).
cards.ex_t: Quanto se pode ganhar como analista de dados no Funchal?
cards.ex_trans: How much can you earn as a data analyst in Funchal?

cards.ex_t: O imposto sobre o carro paga-se uma vez por ano.
cards.ex_trans: The car tax is paid once a year.

cards.note: Literally 'taxpayer', but in shops it means your NIF: the cashier's 'Contribuinte?' asks whether to put your tax number on the receipt.
cards.ex_t: No supermercado perguntam sempre se quero contribuinte na fatura.
cards.ex_trans: At the supermarket they always ask if I want my tax number on the receipt.

cards.note: False friend: in pt-PT this is retirement or the pension, not 'reform'. Brazil says 'aposentadoria'; 'reformado' = retired.
cards.ex_t: A minha vizinha do prédio já está na reforma.
cards.ex_trans: My neighbour in the building is already retired.

cards.ex_t: Amanhã é feriado e o escritório está fechado.
cards.ex_trans: Tomorrow is a public holiday and the office is closed.

cards.note: Always plural: 'as férias são em agosto'.
cards.ex_t: Em agosto tiro duas semanas de férias para caminhar nas levadas.
cards.ex_trans: In August I take two weeks of holidays to walk the levadas.

cards.ex_t: Na segunda tenho folga e vou ao mercado logo de manhã.
cards.ex_trans: On Monday I have a day off and I'm going to the market first thing in the morning.

cards.trans: schedule; timetable — and, in Madeira, the bus itself
cards.note: Madeira only: «apanhar o horário» means to catch the bus. On the mainland that is «o autocarro».
cards.ex_t: O horário dos autocarros muda nos feriados.
cards.ex_trans: The bus timetable changes on public holidays.

cards.note: The office as a place — a desk is 'a secretária' (which also means 'secretary'). Spanish 'escritorio' (desk) misleads here.
cards.ex_t: O escritório fica perto do teleférico, no centro do Funchal.
cards.ex_trans: The office is near the cable car, in the centre of Funchal.
